nodes.label: graphify usage rules: graphify query/path/explain before grep or file reads, wiki/index.md for navigation, GRAPH_REPORT.md only for broad review, graphify update . after code changes, graph.json diffs expected
nodes.norm_label: graphify usage rules: graphify query/path/explain before grep or file reads, wiki/index.md for navigation, graph_report.md only for broad review, graphify update . after code changes, graph.json diffs expected
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output; `graphify update .` is AST-only with no API cost; graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, so a large diff in a pull request is expected and is not churn or a reason to skip the rebuild or its hooks.

nodes.rationale: graphify treats index.html as a document, not code, so the AST-only `graphify update .` never refreshes its nodes; only the skill-driven rebuild does.

nodes.label: Bilingual EN/ID system: paired [lang] elements hidden via html[data-lang] (tanyasaya-chat excluded) plus data-ph / data-al / data-alt attribute pairs
nodes.norm_label: bilingual en/id system: paired [lang] elements hidden via html[data-lang] (tanyasaya-chat excluded) plus data-ph / data-al / data-alt attribute pairs
nodes.rationale: Every visible text ships in EN and ID (project rule in CLAUDE.md). One CSS rule hides the inactive language, so switching is a single data-lang flip with no re-render; tanyasaya-chat is excluded so the chat widget, which manages its own language, is never hidden by the page rule. Text that JS writes, such as the rotating I build word, comes from EN / ID lists keyed by lang() and is re-rendered on a switch.

nodes.rationale: graphify treats HTML as a document rather than code, so its nodes are only refreshed by the skill-driven rebuild.

nodes.label: Animated ASCII field [data-ascii]: two stacked pre layers draw plasma noise through a density ramp ( .:-=+*#%@) at about 24 fps, with the ImDev mark dissolving in and out on the bright layer and a cursor or tap ripple; sized to the card (cols×rows in the header), paused off-screen or in a hidden tab, one static frame under reduced motion
nodes.norm_label: animated ascii field [data-ascii]: two stacked pre layers draw plasma noise through a density ramp ( .:-=+*#%@) at about 24 fps, with the imdev mark dissolving in and out on the bright layer and a cursor or tap ripple; sized to the card (cols×rows in the header), paused off-screen or in a hidden tab, one static frame under reduced motion
nodes.rationale: Plain text in two pre elements (a dim field and a bright mark layer) instead of a canvas keeps the effect monochrome and styleable from CSS. The requestAnimationFrame loop is throttled to 42ms and runs only while an IntersectionObserver reports the field visible and the tab is not hidden; a ResizeObserver re-measures the character grid. Under reduced motion it draws a single frame (t = 2.4s) and attaches no pointer handlers. Mouse moves steer the ripple; a touch tap lights it for 1.1s.

nodes.label: Cursor-stretch kinetic type stretch(zone, letters, amp): letters near the mouse stretch vertically through --sy (CSS scale on .ht-c and .kc), batched in requestAnimationFrame; applied to the hero headline letters (amp .2) and the I build letters (amp .24); fine pointers and motionOK only
nodes.norm_label: cursor-stretch kinetic type stretch(zone, letters, amp): letters near the mouse stretch vertically through --sy (css scale on .ht-c and .kc), batched in requestanimationframe; applied to the hero headline letters (amp .2) and the i build letters (amp .24); fine pointers and motionok only
nodes.rationale: The pull falls off with horizontal and vertical distance from each letter's centre and resets on pointerleave; touch and pen pointers are ignored. Using the individual CSS scale property keeps the stretch independent of the transform-based letter reveal and the headline's scroll skew, and a .35s scale transition smooths it.

nodes.label: drawWave(): cubic Bezier path through the timeline node centres, sets the SVG viewBox and --len for the stroke-draw animation, skipped while the wave is hidden
nodes.norm_label: drawwave(): cubic bezier path through the timeline node centres, sets the svg viewbox and --len for the stroke-draw animation, skipped while the wave is hidden
nodes.rationale: Built from the measured node positions so the curve passes through the dots at any width; --len lets the stroke draw itself when the timeline is revealed.

nodes.label: Flying portrait card (.fly): clone of img/portrait.webp that travels from slot a (hero) into slot b (About), flipping once on the way
nodes.norm_label: flying portrait card (.fly): clone of img/portrait.webp that travels from slot a (hero) into slot b (about), flipping once on the way
nodes.rationale: One clone sized to slot b stands in for both portrait slots (hidden via .has-fly) so the photo appears to fly; past 90deg the image is mirrored back so it reads correctly after the 180deg flip.

nodes.label: Hero headline letter split [data-title] with hover scramble on fine pointers (motionOK only, .ready reveal with a 2.5s CSS failsafe)
nodes.norm_label: hero headline letter split [data-title] with hover scramble on fine pointers (motionok only, .ready reveal with a 2.5s css failsafe)
nodes.rationale: The visual lines are aria-hidden while the full name and role sit in an .sr span; the title is hidden under .js-motion only until JS marks it .ready, and a 2.5s CSS failsafe keeps it from ever staying invisible.

nodes.norm_label: measurefly(): measures slot a and slot b into geo (centres, widths, scroll distance), hides the fly card when a slot is not laid out

nodes.label: prefers-reduced-motion CSS override: 1ms animations and transitions, scroll-behavior auto
nodes.norm_label: prefers-reduced-motion css override: 1ms animations and transitions, scroll-behavior auto
nodes.rationale: One universal rule also stops the CSS-only loops that have no JS gate (hero grain, ticker marquee, timeline ping, route march).

nodes.label: relayout(): recomputes hero height, measureFly + renderFly + drawWave; debounced on resize and ResizeObserver, also on load, fonts.ready and language change
nodes.norm_label: relayout(): recomputes hero height, measurefly + renderfly + drawwave; debounced on resize and resizeobserver, also on load, fonts.ready and language change
nodes.rationale: The fly geometry and the wave path depend on rendered text, so they are re-measured after load, once webfonts are ready, on resize and after a language switch.

nodes.label: renderTicker(v): eases the ticker's Web Animations playbackRate toward 1 + |v| × 0.14 (capped at 6x), reversed while scrolling up, via updatePlaybackRate; reports whether the rate is still settling
nodes.norm_label: renderticker(v): eases the ticker's web animations playbackrate toward 1 + |v| × 0.14 (capped at 6x), reversed while scrolling up, via updateplaybackrate; reports whether the rate is still settling
nodes.rationale: The animation handle comes from getAnimations() only when motionOK. Returning the settling state keeps the scroll loop requesting frames after scrolling stops, until the ticker has eased back to its normal forward speed.

nodes.label: Kinetic word rotator (kinReset, scrambleTo): every 3.2s the I build word scrambles through ASCII glyphs into the next of six EN / ID focus areas (Business Systems, Indoor Navigation, Financial Platforms, RAG Chatbots, Real-time Games, Automations) and updates the dots and 01-06 index; pauses on hover, off-screen or in a hidden tab
nodes.norm_label: kinetic word rotator (kinreset, scrambleto): every 3.2s the i build word scrambles through ascii glyphs into the next of six en / id focus areas (business systems, indoor navigation, financial platforms, rag chatbots, real-time games, automations) and updates the dots and 01-06 index; pauses on hover, off-screen or in a hidden tab
nodes.rationale: Runs only under motionOK; otherwise the first focus area stays static. The words exist in both languages and kinReset re-renders the current one when the language flips, so the JS-written word follows the bilingual rule without paired [lang] elements. Each letter settles on its own randomised frame (34ms ticks) and glyphs are HTML-escaped before innerHTML. The same block splits the I build lead into .kc letters for the cursor stretch, and pausing while the pointer is over the copy lets a reader finish the word.

nodes.label: motionOK — prefers-reduced-motion gate (with the boot script's js-motion class and the CSS override): no scramble, cursor stretch, word rotation, ASCII animation, scroll-driven ticker, flying portrait, parallax, reveals, band motion or View Transition under reduced motion
nodes.norm_label: motionok — prefers-reduced-motion gate (with the boot script's js-motion class and the css override): no scramble, cursor stretch, word rotation, ascii animation, scroll-driven ticker, flying portrait, parallax, reveals, band motion or view transition under reduced motion
nodes.rationale: Project rule: keep all motion gated by prefers-reduced-motion. Scripts check motionOK before splitting, scrambling, stretching, rotating the I build word, animating the ASCII field, steering the ticker, flying, parallaxing, revealing or animating the band; the ASCII field then shows one static frame and the I build word stays on its first focus area. Intro states only apply under html.js-motion, so content stays visible with reduced motion or without JS; the CSS media query cuts any remaining animation, such as the ticker marquee and the hero grain, to 1ms.

nodes.label: Tech ticker [data-ticker]: full-width marquee of alternating solid and outlined tech words (Claude Code, TypeScript, C# · .NET, Cloudflare Edge, MapLibre GL, RAG Systems, PostgreSQL, React 19, Durable Objects) on a 44s CSS loop whose speed and direction follow the scroll; pauses on hover
nodes.norm_label: tech ticker [data-ticker]: full-width marquee of alternating solid and outlined tech words (claude code, typescript, c# · .net, cloudflare edge, maplibre gl, rag systems, postgresql, react 19, durable objects) on a 44s css loop whose speed and direction follow the scroll; pauses on hover
nodes.rationale: The word group is duplicated (the copy aria-hidden) and the track slides by -50%, so the loop is seamless. The CSS animation is the baseline and script only changes its playbackRate, so under reduced motion the CSS override stops the loop and no rate control is attached.

nodes.description: 880x1155 portrait-orientation WebP (RGB, no alpha, 32,150 bytes), fully grayscale. A young man with thick dark wavy hair and a tousled fringe, black thick-rimmed rectangular glasses and a plain light crew-neck T-shirt with a ribbed collar, smiling with closed lips and looking off-camera toward the viewer's right. He is centered and cropped at the chest, with empty headroom above, on a flat near-white (#fefefe) background: a clean editorial headshot. index.html's alt text names him as Devaldi Caliesta Octadiani, the site owner. The page preloads it and shows it in the hero card (bilingual EN/ID alt text, fetchpriority=high) and again, decoratively with an empty alt, in the About card.

nodes.label: ImDev Favicon Mark
nodes.description: 64x64 SVG favicon and the site's brand mark: a near-black (#141414) rounded-square tile (rx=14) carrying an off-white (#f1f1ee) corner-bracket glyph, a thick top bar running into an equally thick right-hand vertical stroke (reads like a reversed L or a stylized 7). Two flat colours only, no text or gradients. Both fills equal the default dark-theme tokens in public/index.html (:root --bg #141414, --fg/--inv #f1f1ee) and the theme-color meta (#141414, switched to #f1f1ee in light mode). public/index.html links it via <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">, and public/_headers caches it for 7 days.
nodes.norm_label: imdev favicon mark
nodes.rationale: Inferred intent: the icon reuses the page's own background and foreground colours, so the browser tab, the theme-color bar and the dark page read as one monochrome identity.

nodes.label: Near-Black Rounded Square (#141414)
nodes.description: Background <rect width="64" height="64" rx="14" fill="#141414">: a full-bleed app-icon tile with rounded corners (radius about 22% of the side), the same value as the site's dark --bg token.
nodes.norm_label: near-black rounded square (#141414)

nodes.label: Off-White Corner Bracket Glyph (#f1f1ee)
nodes.description: Foreground <path d="M14 14H50V50H36.3V27.7H14Z" fill="#f1f1ee">: a 36x36 corner bracket inset 14 units on every side, made of a full-width top bar and a right-hand stroke that are both 13.7 units thick (about 38% of the glyph box). Normalised to percentages it is the same polygon as the chat widget's mark in public/nara-widget.css (--w-mark: polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 100%,62% 100%,62% 38%,0 38%), used as the .avatar clip-path).
nodes.norm_label: off-white corner bracket glyph (#f1f1ee)
